title: IRFEN Pedregal clean-room authorized consumers
description: Closed list of the only scripts/roles ever permitted to read Pedregal sealed evidence through the fail-closed loader, after a safe-unblind has been authorized. Empty by design until a canonical unblind decision exists and names them explicitly.

script_path.description: Repository-relative path to the single script authorized to call the loader for this consumer_id.

canonical_decision_ref.description: decision_id of the manifest's canonical_unblind_decision that authorized this specific consumer. Must match the manifest's current canonical_unblind_decision.decision_id or the loader refuses access.
